_comment: #464 Fishy board -> assets/sprites/fishy.png (+ resources/sprites/fishy_frames.tres). The board already has real transparency (glow/smoke are partial alpha), so it packs with pack_alpha_strip.py, not extract_frames.py. Run: python3 -I tools/sprites/pack_alpha_strip.py pack tools/sprites/specs/fishy.json <board.png> assets/sprites/fishy.png --tres resources/sprites/fishy_frames.tres. Origins were measured with a scratch Godot script: x = green-hair centroid - 96 (body centre), y = lowest boot pixel - 153 (feet on cell row ~51). Sheet: 8 columns, cells 64x52, frame index i -> row i//8, col i%8. 0-2 front idle (board row 6 cols 5-7), 3-5 front walk (board rows 1-3 col 1), 6-10 cast wind-up (board row 4 cols 1-5), 11 cast hold (row 4 col 6, line cut at the rod tip), 12-15 reel (row 5 cols 4-7), 16-19 retract (row 6 cols 1-4), 20 the hook (row 4 col 6's hook).
